Be it remembered that Letters of Administration of the estate of Sarah Hansor deceased were granted to John Durham next of kin of the said Sarah Hansor. Inventory to be exhibited on or before the Eighth Day of August next and an account on or before the eighth Day of February Anno Dom Seventeen hundred and seventy two. Given under the seal of Office of the Register the eighth day of February anno dom seventeen hundred and seventy one. Be it remembered that Letters of Administration of the estate of Sarah Hansor deceased were granted to John Durham next of kin of the said Sarah Hansor. Inventory to be exhibited on or before the Eighth Day of August next and an account on or before the eighth Day of February Anno Dom Seventeen hundred and seventy two. Given under the seal of Office of the Register the eighth day of February anno dom seventeen hundred and seventy one. 


An Inventory of the Estate of Sarah Handzer, Deceased 
9 February. 
1771
 

An Inventory of the Goods & Chattles of Sarah Hansor  Dec'd Appraised by us the Subscribers Feb. 9th, 
1771
. 

To her Wearing Apparel....................................0..7..6  
To 1 Bed and Furniture To Pot & Skillet ..................2..7..6  
To 1 hoe and 1 Ax  3/.....................................0..3..0  
To old Chest To and old Wheel old Table...................0..7..6  
To 1 Tub and pails 3/ some old pewter.....................0..3..0  
and spoons some old Earthenware...........................0..3..0  
and 2 old Baskets.........................................0..3..0  
To 1 Bag 1 Barrel 3/ one Looking Glass 1/.................0..4..0  
To 2 Geese one Turkey 2 Fowls ............................0..6..0 
To a parcel of Corn in the Ears...........................0..4..6  
To one Sow and five shoates...............................1..5..0  
To a parcel of unbroke Flax...............................0..3..0   
(total)                                                   5..14..4   
William Corse 
John Torbert 



Kent Co. DE 
Reg. of Wills, Liber N, page 67
24 December, 
1793
 

Francis Denny adm. wth. the will annexed of John Durham deceased who was adm. of Sarah Handzer deceased Exhibited to the Register an account of said Sarah Handzor deceaseds' Estate. The same was Examined, proved allowed and passed and therein appears a balance of two pounds seven shillings remaining in the hands of Adm. as the account field at large may appear, this twenty fourth Day of December in the year of our Lord One thousand seven hundred and ninety three. 

Francis Denny administrator of John Durham deceased who was adm. of Sarah Handzor deceased begs leave to (unclear) the following acc't of said Sarah Handzor deceased .

The Estate of Sarah Handzor 
To Cash paid for Letter of Adm.........................0. 17..3  
To Funeral Expences................................... 3..10...

(subtotal).............................................4..14..9
